_comment: Centralized development configuration for the Mehua Lashes deposit-concierge prototype. This is the canonical source of truth for these values — edit here first. The n8n workflow embeds a copy of this object in each 'Load Mehua Config' node (n8n has no clean cross-branch config include without an Execute Workflow sub-node, which isn't set up yet — see workflows/README.md). Keep those copies in sync with this file until that's fixed.

deposit._status: CONFIRMED: amount=500 MUR, method=Juice. payment_details is a placeholder — do not invent a phone number/account.

_reminder_timing_status: TO_VALIDATE: 48h escalation window is from the source research (Mauritius_SME_Automation_Feasibility_Study.pdf), not yet confirmed directly with the owner. 20h resend cooldown is our own assumption to avoid spamming the owner with a reminder every 4-hour check cycle — not sourced from any document.
_payment_status_rule: Only an explicit owner action (the 'Owner Form - Review Deposit Verification' form, Verification Result = Verified) may move a booking into DEPOSIT_VERIFIED. No OCR, AI model, screenshot analysis or text recognition may ever set this status. Receiving a screenshot only moves a booking to AWAITING_MANUAL_VERIFICATION, never DEPOSIT_VERIFIED directly.

templates._status: TEMPORARY — OWNER WORDING TO VALIDATE. These are development placeholders, not Mehua's real customer-facing wording. Do not send any of these to a real customer. Merge fields use {{double_braces}} and are filled by the workflow's own renderTemplate() code, not by n8n's expression engine.
